Re: Integrate long running R jobs using yarn-cluster

Some design notes: Integrating SparkR with yarn-cluster will require adding a new Java-based main class like PythonRunner https://github.com/apache/spark/blob/master/core/src/main/scala/org/apache/spark/deploy/PythonRunner.scala

We should figure out if we can read the system properties, environment variables without starting the java gateway (as in the PythonRunner)
